description.value: Witch's Brew Cafe (also styled as Witch's Brew Cafe Bakeshop on Facebook) is a cafe located on Vancouver Island, BC. It appears to be a locally operated establishment offering cafe and baked goods. Touring cyclists riding routes along the island would find it a potential stop for refreshments.
